'''Vol Argen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the Balmorran Defense Minister before the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|invasion]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he returned to Balmorra, though Argen and his bodyguards were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an Imperial individual in the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]].
